title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Canadian Open?
background: The Canadian Open is a major hard-court tennis tournament held during the build-up to the US Open.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official WTA results for the 2026 Canadian Open will determine the women's singles champion.
  • Resolution Timing: The question resolves when the tournament's women's singles final is completed and its result is officially recorded.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the winning player's full name.

title: Which country will the Spanish Football Federation announce as the host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup?
background: The Spanish Super Cup features the winners and runners-up of La Liga and the Copa del Rey. Saudi Arabia has hosted the competition since 2020.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Spanish Football Federation’s official host announcement, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country officially named as host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup by August 31, 2026. This question concerns the announced host, not whether the tournament subsequently takes place there. Resolution occurs when the announcement is made.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the host country, rather than the host city or stadium.

title: Who will score Bangladesh's first men's Test century on Australian soil?
background: A Test century is an individual score of at least 100 runs in a single innings. No Bangladesh batter has yet achieved this milestone in a men's Test played in Australia.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Test match scorecards and contemporaneous reputable cricket reporting confirming the first such century.
  • Resolution Condition: The question resolves when a player representing Bangladesh first reaches 100 runs in a single innings of an official men's Test match played in Australia.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The batter's full name.

title: Which club will lead Major League Soccer's Eastern Conference at the end of play on August 19, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official MLS Eastern Conference standings, applying the league's official tiebreaking rules if necessary
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-19 (after all matches dated August 19, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: The club's name

title: Which Indonesian province will be struck by the country's deadliest earthquake between January 1 and August 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the province identified as the location of Indonesia's deadliest earthquake occurring from January 1 through August 17, 2026. Determine the deadliest earthquake using fatalities reported by Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency as of August 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.

title: Who will win the women's 50m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official championship results published by the organizers or World Aquatics, corroborated by contemporaneous sports reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 50m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The swimmer's full name.

title: Who will leave UFC 330 as the UFC women's strawweight champion?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UFC's official event results and championship recognition, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter recognized as the undisputed UFC women's strawweight champion immediately after the division's title bout at UFC 330. Use the fight-night outcome, excluding subsequent title changes or reversals.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

title: If Novak Djokovic loses a men's singles match at the 2026 Cincinnati Open, which player will defeat him?
background: Djokovic has won three Cincinnati singles titles, most recently in 2023. The tournament is a major hard-court event leading up to the US Open.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Cincinnati Open or ATP Tour match results for the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution: Resolve when Djokovic records a men's singles defeat at the tournament, using the identity of his winning opponent. If Djokovic wins the title or withdraws without losing a match, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning opponent's full name.

title: Who will win the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UFC's official event results, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330. Use the result announced on fight night, excluding any subsequent reversal.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning fighter's full name.

title: Who will win the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official championship results published by the organizers or World Aquatics, corroborated by contemporaneous sports reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 800m freestyle at the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The swimmer's full name.

title: Which club will win the 2026 FA Community Shield?
background: The FA Community Shield is English football's traditional curtain-raiser ahead of the domestic league season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Football Association's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the result.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the club that wins the 2026 FA Community Shield, including a victory by penalty shootout if applicable.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name.

title: Which country will win the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations?
background: The Women’s Africa Cup of Nations is Africa’s continental championship for senior women’s national football teams.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Confederation of African Football’s official result for the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations final.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country whose national team is declared champion following the final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s name.

title: Who will win the 2026 St Jude Championship on the PGA Tour?
background: The St Jude Championship is the opening tournament of the PGA Tour's FedEx Cup playoffs.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 St Jude Championship.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the tournament concludes and its champion is officially determined, including any playoff if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.

title: Which country will finish top of Pool D at the 2026 men's Hockey World Cup?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official tournament standings for Pool D, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve once all Pool D matches in the initial pool stage have concluded in August 2026. Use the country ranked first under the tournament's official standings and tiebreaking rules.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the country finishing first in Pool D.
